si.title: Silicon — sp3 covalent crystal at 300 K

panels.caption: Valence filling [Ne] 3s2 3p2 → four equivalent sp3. Beiser 8.5 / L2.
P(r)=r²R² for 3s and 3p (Clementi–Raimondi Zeff). Half-bond 1.176 Å marked. Beiser 6.7.
|ψ_sp3|² in the y=z plane: two lobes at 109.47°. Neighbours at 2.352 Å.
Ideal tetrahedron in the diamond-cubic cage. a=5.431 Å (300 K). Not an XRD structure.
Atomic → sp3 → VB/CB. Eg=1.12 eV, Eg/kT≈43, ni≈1e10 cm⁻³. Indirect gap.
MATLAB diamond-cubic visualizer already in the repo (structure, not orbitals).
Schematic E–k: VBM at Γ, CBM along Δ toward X (phonon required).

tio2.title: TiO2 — ligand-field / MO picture at 300 K

panels.caption: Formal count: Ti4+ d0 + O2− p6. Empty Ti 3d is the CB, filled O 2p is the VB.
Real 3d |Y|²: eg (dz2, dx2−y2) point at ligands; t2g (dxy, dxz, dyz) between. Beiser 6.7.
TiO6: L2 d2sp3 is a geometry mnemonic; electronic structure is LFT/MO (today’s conclusion).
Oxygen sp2 σ framework (⅓ s + ⅔ p) plus p⊥ π-donor into Ti t2g. Beiser 8.5 / L2.
Hydrogenic P(r) of Ti 3d vs O 2p along a 1.95 Å bond. Slater 3d is much more diffuse.
Eg 3.0 eV (rutile, 413 nm) / 3.2 eV (anatase, 388 nm). kT does not populate the CB. VO donor sketched.

eu3.title: Eu3+ — buried 4f6, 7F0, Boltzmann ladder at 300 K

panels.caption: 4f6 high spin: S=3, L=3, J=|L−S|=0 → 7F0. No hybridization label. Beiser 7.6, 7.8.
Seven real 4f angular |Y|² (l=3 extension of Beiser Table 6.1).
4f lies inside 5s/5p. Shannon r=1.066 Å (CN 8); Eu–O≈2.4 Å. Weak ligand field, ionic bonding.
Ideal CN 8 square antiprism and CN 9 tricapped trigonal prism (idgeometryexplorer). Ligand-dependent.
7F_J + 5D0. kT=208 cm⁻¹. Populations 65.7 / 32.0 / 2.2 %. 590 nm MD, 612 nm ED hypersensitive.
